name: Dermatomyositis
definition: Autoimmune inflammatory myopathy characterized by characteristic skin disease with variable proximal muscle weakness and potential lung, swallowing or malignancy associations.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis uses clinical phenotype, muscle enzymes, antibodies, MRI/EMG and sometimes biopsy.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Immunotherapy and malignancy/ILD screening require specialist-directed assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Rakta-related phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Autoimmune inflammatory myopathy characterized by characteristic skin disease with variable proximal muscle weakness and potential lung, swallowing or malignancy associations.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
